semiconductor_relevance: High — The company specializes in high-end IC substrates, crucial for advanced semiconductor packaging.
summary: Advanced Micro Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the development and production of high-end integrated circuit substrates, specifically FC-BGA substrates. With facilities in Taicang and Anji, China, the company emphasizes early-stage design and rapid production capabilities to serve the semiconductor packaging market.
technical_expertise: Flip Chip Ball Grid Array (FC-BGA) technology

regional_presence.China: The company operates major production facilities in Taicang, Jiangsu, and Anji, Zhejiang, with its headquarters in Anji.
